Follow me and DM me "CODES" on IG/FB only 👇 Most people use ChatGPT like a search box. A better move is giving it a role, standard, or mode before asking the question. These 5 power words change the answer because they change the job ChatGPT thinks it's doing. 1. TRUTHMODE: Honesty instead of compliments. Put it before a prompt when you want the model to push back, name weak logic, and stop glazing. 2. /human: Text with less stiffness. Use it before drafts, captions, emails, and posts when you want output with a more natural rhythm. 3. REDTEAM: Pressure testing. Ask ChatGPT to red team your idea and it will look for flaws, hidden assumptions, missing evidence, and failure points. 4. ELI10: Clarity. It pushes the answer into simple language without making you feel talked down to. 5. FUTUREYOU: Advice with perspective. Ask from the version of you who already handled the problem, and the answer often gets calmer and more useful. What are the best ChatGPT prompt words? How do I make ChatGPT more honest? There is a GitHub repo that turns Claude into a full video production studio, and it is free. OpenMontage makes your AI coding assistant the director: you type a plain-language brief and the agent runs research, proposal, script, scene plan, assets, edit and compose, then hands you one finished MP4. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and Codex. Zero API keys required for a real video: Piper narration runs offline, footage comes from Archive.org, NASA, Wikimedia, Pexels and Pixabay, and Remotion, HyperFrames and FFmpeg handle composition and subtitles. Every creative stage has an approval gate, and the checkpoint writer refuses to mark a stage complete without your recorded yes. It reviews its own render before you see it: ffprobe checks, frame pulls for black frames, audio levels, subtitle presence. 12 production pipelines cover animated explainers, documentary montages, talking heads, screen demos, podcast repurposing and dubbing. I ran the install and the zero-key demo on my own machine on Sep 14: clean setup, four videos rendered, no errors. 59,493 GitHub stars as of Sep 16, up from 13.7K in June, number one repo of the day on GitHub Trending.
